# nginxproxymanager_user_permissions

Resource behaviour:
- During an `apply`, the permissions user's permissions are set.
- During a `delete`, the permissions user's permissions revert to default. **Deleting does not set all permissions to the lowest value.**

**This resource does not support importing.**

## Example Usage 

```terraform
resource "nginxproxymanager_user" "example" {
  name     = "test1"
  nickname = "test_nickname yes"
  email    = "test2@test.com"
  roles    = ["user"]
}

resource "nginxproxymanager_user_permissions" "example" {
  user_id = nginxproxymanager_user.test.id
  permissions {
    visibility        = "all"
    proxy_hosts       = "hidden"
    redirection_hosts = "view"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (Number) ID of the user (required).

### Optional

- `permissions` (Block, Optional) Permissions to grant the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--permissions))
